paragraphs: We design, convert, own and operate marine infrastructure for the liquefaction of natural gas, and are a leading provider of FLNG as a service. We believe that natural gas has a critical role to play in providing cleaner energy for many years to come. Our pioneering infrastructure solutions provide safe, competitive and sustainable ways of liquefying gas globally. Our mission is to be recognized as an organization with an outstanding reputation for safe, reliable and cost-effective operations; to employ and develop talented people who appreciate the impact of their work towards the Company's mission; to develop a portfolio of new FLNG infrastructure opportunities and convert the best opportunities into world-class projects; and to be a great business partner, where combining skills and resources makes a big difference.

Our strategy is to provide market-leading FLNG operations and maintain balance sheet flexibility to maximize shareholder returns through accretive FLNG projects. We offer gas resource holders a proven, capital efficient and timely solution to monetize stranded, associated, flared or otherwise underutilized gas reserves. Our industry leading FLNG operational track record and FLNG growth prospects allow gas resource holders, developers and customers access to a low-cost, low-risk, rapidly deployable solution for natural gas liquefaction.

FLNG projects provide a solution for gas reserves where geographical, technical, political and economic constraints limit monetization through traditional infrastructure. Our standardized FLNG units can be redeployed to new opportunities after producing a field and offer a viable economic alternative to large-scale land-based projects. Our liquefaction solution and accelerated execution model place liquefaction technology onboard an existing LNG carrier, converting such carriers into a fully commissioned FLNG. As of March 16, 2026, we are currently the only company with a proven track-record to deliver FLNG as a service to gas resource owners.

The FLNG industry is in the early stages of development, and we do not currently face significant competition from other providers of FLNG services. There are currently nine FLNGs on the water, including our two that provide liquefaction as a service (FLNG Hilli and FLNG Gimi), six FLNGs being used to liquefy the resource holder's own gas and one being used to liquefy gas to service its downstream portfolio. Further, there are currently five FLNGs under conversion or construction, including our MKII FLNG. We anticipate that more companies will enter the FLNG industry at some point in the future, resulting in greater competition.

We are listed on Nasdaq under the ticker "GLNG". We are incorporated under the name Golar LNG Limited as an exempted company under the Bermuda Companies Act of 1981 in the Islands of Bermuda on May 10, 2001, and our registered office is at 2nd Floor, S.E. Pearman Building, 9 Par-la-Ville Road, Hamilton HM 11, Bermuda. Our telephone number at that address is +(1) 441 295 4705. Our principal administrative office is located at 6th Floor, The Zig Zag, 70 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6SQ, United Kingdom and our telephone number at that address is +44 207 063 7900. The Commission maintains an internet site that contains reports, proxy and information statements, and other information that we file electronically with the Commission and this can be obtained from the Commission's website at (http://www.sec.gov) or from the "SEC filings" tab in the "Investor Relations" section of our website (www.golarlng.com). Information contained on our website does not constitute part of this annual report.

Our operations have evolved from LNG shipping, floating regasification, floating liquefaction and combined cycle gas fired power to a focus on floating liquefaction operations as we executed a strategic transformation to simplify our business to unlock value and deleverage our balance sheet.
Key developments during the past three years include the following:
•Golar Arctic: In March 2025, we completed the sale of our last LNG carrier for $24.8 million. Following this sale, we have fully exited our legacy shipping business.
•Avenir LNG: In January 2025, we sold our equity method investment in Avenir for $39.1 million.
•Golar Gandria: In May 2023, we disposed of our LNG carrier, Gandria, for net proceeds of $15.2 million.

•Listed equity holdings: In 2023, we divested our holdings of 1.2 million shares in New Fortress Energy Inc. ("NFE") and 4.5 million shares in Cool Company Ltd ("CoolCo"), generating total proceeds of $45.6 million and $56.1 million, respectively. In March 2023, we also exchanged our remaining 4.1 million NFE shares and $100.0 million in cash for NFE's common units in FLNG Hilli.

•FLNG Gimi: In June 2025, FLNG Gimi reached COD, triggering the commencement of the 20-year LOA for the GTA Project unlocking approximately $4.3 billion of Adjusted EBITDA backlog, of which Golar's share is approximately $3.0 billion.

•FLNG Hilli: In December 2024, we acquired the remaining non-controlling interest in FLNG Hilli for $59.9 million, resulting in full ownership of FLNG Hilli. In May 2025, we satisfied all conditions precedent in connection with agreements with SESA for a 20-year deployment of FLNG Hilli offshore Argentina, commencing in 2027. The contract is expected to generate approximately $5.7 billion in Adjusted EBITDA backlog, excluding inflation and commodity-linked upside.

•MKII FLNG: In September 2024, we executed the EPC agreement with CIMC for our first 3.5 mtpa MKII FLNG conversion, with an estimated total project cost of approximately $2.2 billion (excluding financing costs) and delivery expected in the fourth quarter of 2027. In October 2025, we satisfied all conditions precedent in connection with agreements with SESA for a 20-year deployment of the MKII FLNG offshore Argentina, commencing in 2028. The contract is expected to generate approximately $8.0 billion in Adjusted EBITDA backlog, excluding inflation and commodity-linked upside.

paragraphs: The risk factors summarized and detailed below could materially and adversely affect our business, our financial condition, our results of operations and the trading price of our common shares. We have categorized the risks we face based on whether they arise from our FLNG projects, FLNG operations, financing activities, from the industry in which we operate, matters specific to our common shares and taxation. The order in which these risks are presented reflects management's assessment of their relative significance. Where relevant, we have grouped together related risks into the following categories:
■Our ability to meet our obligations in connection with FLNG Hilli's refurbishment and the conversion of the MKII FLNG and their respective charters to SESA;
■Our heavy reliance on a limited number of contractors, suppliers and shipyards with relevant specialized experience, given the sophisticated nature of FLNG conversions; and
■Our ability to develop, structure and execute a fourth FLNG aligned with specific customer requirements and conversion strategy.
■Our ability to meet our continuing obligations under the LOA entered into in connection with the FLNG Gimi;
■Our ability to meet our continuing obligations under the LTA entered into in connection with the FLNG Hilli;

paragraphs: The following discussion of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the sections of this Annual Report entitled "Item 4. Information on the Company" and our consolidated financial statements included herein. Our financial statements have been prepared in accordance with U.S. GAAP. This discussion includes forward-looking statements based on assumptions about our future business. You should also review the section of this Annual Report entitled "Cautionary Statement Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and "Item 3. Key Information - D. Risk Factors" for a discussion of important factors that could cause our actual results to differ materially from the results described in or implied by certain forward-looking statements.
Significant developments since January 1, 2026 until March 16, 2026 are discussed below. •Release of restricted cash – LNG Hrvatska performance guarantees

In July 2025, we entered into an agreement with LNG Hrvatska to mutually terminate the Operate and Maintain ("O&M") agreement prior to its contractual expiry date. Under the deed of termination, the two cash-backed performance guarantees related to the O&M agreement were discharged. In January 2026, the restricted cash plus accrued interest associated to the performance guarantees amounting to $13.3 million was released.
In February 2026, we declared a dividend of $0.25 per share in respect of the three months ended December 31, 2025 to shareholders of record on March 9, 2026, which was paid on March 18, 2026.
In February 2026, we entered into a credit agreement under which we agreed to provide SESA, as borrower, with a credit facility of up to $5.6 million.

Subsequent to execution of the agreement, SESA has drawn $2.6 million under the facility. Amounts drawn bear interest at Term SOFR plus a margin of 3.875%, with interest payable semi-annually. The loan matures on April 15, 2029, with principal repayable in two equal semi-annual installments.

In March 2026, we sold our entire 2.69% shareholding in OLT Offshore LNG Toscana S.p.A., which was fully impaired in 2019, pursuant to a Sale and Purchase Agreement with SNAM S.p.A. for a consideration of $3.1 million.

In March 2026, a formal process to evaluate strategic alternatives to accelerate our FLNG growth pipeline and maximize shareholder value was initiated. In connection with this process, we have appointed Goldman Sachs International as our financial advisor. The strategic review will include a comprehensive evaluation of Golar's platform, including our industry-leading FLNG technology, long-term contract backlog, and growth pipeline. Potential alternatives to be explored include, but are not limited to, a sale of the Company, a merger or other business combination, divestiture of assets, or further optimization of the corporate structure. The Company will target solutions that unlock shareholder value and enable faster roll-out of Golar's FLNG growth pipeline. There can be no assurance that the strategic review will result in any transaction or other strategic outcome, nor have we established a definitive timetable for the completion of this process.
Our historical results of operations may not be indicative of our future results of operations which may be principally affected for the following reasons:

•Utilization of the FLNG Gimi and our continued obligations under the LOA. During the term of the LOA, we remain exposed to key risks, including underperformance against contracted capacity, payment disputes or defaults, termination events, and unforeseen costs or liabilities. Our ability to sustain or enhance FLNG Gimi's economics depends on delivering consistent operational performance and executing production optimization initiatives, which may require additional capital investment or regulatory approvals and may not generate the expected returns. Any vessel unavailability, shortfall in production, material cost overruns, contractual termination, or prolonged operational disruption could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations, cash flows, and financial condition.

•Utilization of FLNG Hilli under the remaining LTA term. With the LTA maturing in mid-July 2026, FLNG Hilli remains well positioned to deliver reliable production and strong cash flow generation through the end of the contract term. We continue to focus on maximizing operational uptime and performance to fully capture the remaining contractual value. In parallel, we are executing a structured exit from Cameroon, with clear plans in place to ensure compliance with all applicable legal, tax, social and environmental requirements. Through proactive stakeholder engagement, we are committed to completing the transition responsibly while protecting shareholder value and financial performance. However, any failure to comply with applicable requirements or to execute the transition as planned could have a material adverse effect on our results of operations, cash flows, and financial condition.

•Timely execution of the FLNG Hill's pre-deployment refurbishment. Following the LTA's contractual maturity, FLNG Hilli will undertake a planned $350 million refurbishment program to upgrade the vessel and extend her economic life ahead of her 20-year redeployment with SESA in Argentina. This investment is expected to position Hilli for long-term, stable cash flow generation under a new contract and reinforces the strategic value of the asset within our portfolio. We are required to satisfy certain contractual obligations with SESA, including timely delivery of the vessel onsite and compliance with agreed technical performance specifications. While we have established detailed project plans and oversight structures to support disciplined execution, the refurbishment remains subject to customary project risks, including contractor performance and delays, cost inflation and supply chain constraints. Any material delays, cost overruns or failure to meet contractual specifications could lead to reduced or deferred revenues and higher capital expenditures than anticipated, which could adversely affect our results of operations, cash flows and financial condition.

•Timely and on budget conversion of the MKII FLNG. The MKII FLNG is the first application of Golar's MKII design and is supported by a 20-year contract with SESA. The conversion requires significant technical execution, complex project management and substantial capital investment. In addition, we are required to meet specified delivery milestones and performance standards under the SESA contract. As with any large-scale conversion project, execution is subject to risks, including contractor performance and delays, cost escalation, supply chain constraints and permitting or regulatory approvals. Any material delays, cost overruns or failure to achieve contractual performance specifications could negatively impact project economics and delay the commencement of revenue generation.

•Customer concentration. Our operating revenues are generated from a limited number of customers under long-term contracts, one of which will mature in July 2026. The temporary reduction in earnings associated with the transition of one of our assets could adversely affect our results of operations, cash flows and financial condition. This interim revenue and cash flow gap is expected to narrow as FLNG Hilli commences its 20-year contract with SESA in 2027 and when the MKII FLNG begins operations in 2028, materially strengthening our revenue base.

paragraphs: 我們設計、轉換、擁有並營運海洋基礎建設，用以液化天然氣，並為FLNG服務提供領先的解決方案。我們認為天然氣在未來許多年內，在提供更清潔能源方面扮演關鍵角色。我們的創新基礎建設解決方案提供安全、具有競爭力且可持續的方式，用以全球範圍內液化天然氣。我們的使命是被認可為一個在安全、可靠且成本效益高的運營方面具有良好聲譽的組織；聘僱並培養能體認其工作對本公司使命影響的優秀人才；發展新的FLNG基礎建設機會組合，並將最佳機會轉化為世界級的項目；並成為優秀的商業夥伴，透過結合技能與資源產生重大影響。
我們的策略是提供市場領先的FLNG運營，並維持資產負債表的靈活性，以透過有吸引力的FLNG項目最大化股東回報。我們為天然氣資源持有者提供經過驗證、資金效率高且具備時間效益的解決方案，用以實現被遺忘、伴生、燃燒或未充分利用的天然氣儲備的價值。我們在FLNG運營方面的行業領先紀錄與FLNG成長前景，使天然氣資源持有者、開發者與客戶能獲得低成本、低風險且快速部署的解決方案，用以液化天然氣。

FLNG項目為那些因地理、技術、政治與經濟限制而無法透過傳統基礎建設實現價值的天然氣儲備提供解決方案。我們的標準化FLNG單元在生產完一個油田後，可重新部署至新機會，並為大型陸基項目提供可行的經濟替代方案。我們的液化解決方案與加速執行模式，將液化技術安裝在現有LNG載運船隻上，將這些載運船隻轉化為完全啟用的FLNG。截至2026年3月16日，我們目前是唯一一家擁有經過驗證紀錄，能為天然氣資源持有者提供FLNG服務的公司。

FLNG產業仍處於發展初期，我們目前並未面對來自其他FLNG服務供應商的重大競爭。目前有九艘FLNG船在運行中，包括我們兩艘提供液化服務的FLNG（FLNG Hilli與FLNG Gimi），六艘FLNG用以液化資源持有者自己的天然氣，以及一艘用以液化天然氣以服務其下游組合。此外，目前有五艘FLNG正在轉換或建造中，包括我們的MKII FLNG。我們預期未來會有更多公司進入FLNG產業，導致競爭更加激烈。

我們在納斯達克上市，股票代碼為"GLNG"。我們於2001年5月10日在百慕達根據百慕達公司法（1981年）註冊為豁免公司，公司名稱為Golar LNG Limited，註冊辦公室位於百慕達島的2樓，S.E. Pearman大樓，9 Par-la-Ville Road，Hamilton HM 11。該地址的電話號碼為+(1) 441 295 4705。我們的主要行政辦公室位於英國倫敦的6樓，The Zig Zag，70 Victoria Street，SW1E 6SQ，電話號碼為+44 207 063 7900。證券交易委員會維護一個網站，包含我們向委員會提交的電子檔報告、代理書與資訊聲明及其他資訊，可從委員會網站（http://www.sec.gov）或我們網站的「投資者關係」部分的「SEC filings」選項取得（www.golarlng.com）。我們網站上的資訊不構成本年度報告的一部分。
我們的業務已從LNG運輸、浮動再氣化、浮動液化與燃氣發電組合循環轉變為專注於浮動液化運營，我們執行了一項戰略轉型，以簡化業務、釋放價值並減少資產負債表的負擔。
過去三年的重要發展包括以下內容：
•Golar Arctic：2025年3月，我們完成了最後一艘LNG載運船的出售，售價為24.8百萬美元。完成此筆交易後，我們已完全退出傳統的運輸業務。
•Avenir LNG：於2025年1月，本公司出售對Avenir的權益法投資，獲得39.1 百萬美元。
•Golar Gandria: 2023 年 5 月，本公司將 LNG 載運船 Gandria 售出，取得淨現金收入 15.2 百萬美元。
•FLNG Gimi：於2025年6月，FLNG Gimi達成COD，觸發GTA專案20年LOA的啟動，解鎖約4.3 十億美元的調整後EBITDA積壓訂單，其中Golar所佔權益約為3.0 十億美元。

•FLNG Hilli：於2024年12月，本公司取得FLNG Hilli剩餘非控制性權益，金額為59.9 百萬美元，使本公司取得FLNG Hilli全部股權。於2025年5月，本公司滿足與SESA簽訂之協議所有先決條件，該協議係關於FLNG Hilli在阿根廷離岸地區進行20年部署，自2027年起開始執行。該合約預期將產生約5.7 十億美元之調整後營業息稅前利潤（Adjusted EBITDA）待執行訂單，扣除通貨膨脹及商品連結上漲因素後之數字。

•MKII FLNG：於2024年9月，本公司與 CIMC 簽訂 EPC 合約，執行我們首座 3.5 mtpa MKII FLNG 轉換項目，預估總項目成本約為 2.2 十億美元（不含融資成本），預計於2027年第四季交付。於2025年10月，本公司已滿足與 SESA 簽訂之合約所有先決條件，該合約為 MKII FLNG 在阿根廷 offshore 部署20年，自2028年起啟動。該合約預計將產生約為 8.0 十億美元之 Adjusted EBITDA 預訂 backlog，不含通貨膨脹及商品連結 upside。

paragraphs: 以下關於本公司財務狀況及營運成果之討論，應與本年度報告書中標題為「第 4 項 本公司資訊」之項目及所附之合併財務報表一併閱讀。本公司財務報表係依美國會計準則（U.S. GAAP）編製。本討論包含基於對本公司未來業務之假設所作之預測性陳述。您亦應審閱本年度報告書中標題為「預測性陳述之警示聲明」及「第 3 項 重要資訊 - D. 風險因素」之項目，以瞭解可能導致本公司實際結果與預測性陳述中所描述或暗示之結果有重大差異之重要因素。
自 2026 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 3 月 16 日間之重大發展如下所述。•解除限制性現金 – LNG Hrvatska 保證金履行
2025 年 7 月，本公司與 LNG Hrvatska 籤訂協議，雙方同意於 O&M 協議合約到期日前終止該協議。根據終止協議，與 O&M 協議相關之兩筆現金擔保之履行保證金已解除。2026 年 1 月，與履行保證金相關之限制性現金及累計利息總計 13.3 百萬美元已解除。
2026 年 2 月，本公司宣佈就 2025 年 12 月 31 日止三個月之股息，每股 0.25 美元，發放對象為 2026 年 3 月 9 日截止之股東，該股息於 2026 年 3 月 18 日發放。
2026 年 2 月，本公司與 SESA 籤訂信貸協議，同意為借款人 SESA 提供最高 5.6 百萬美元之信貸融資。
協議簽訂後，SESA 已自信貸融資中提領 2.6 百萬美元。提領金額之利率為 Term SOFR 加上 3.875% 之利差，每半年支付一次利息。貸款於 2029 年 4 月 15 日到期，本金分為兩期均等之半年期償還。
2026 年 3 月，本公司出售本公司持有之 OLT Offshore LNG Toscana S.p.A. 全部 2.69% 股權，該股權於 2019 年已完全減值，根據與 SNAM S.p.A. 籤訂之買賣協議，出售對價為 3.1 百萬美元。

2026 年 3 月，本公司啟動正式程序，評估戰略替代方案以加速 FLNG 成長管道並最大化股東價值。此程序中，本公司已聘請 Goldman Sachs International 作為財務顧問。戰略評估將包括對 Golar 平台之全面評估，包括本公司領先業界的 FLNG 技術、長期合約背書及成長管道。待評估之潛在替代方案包括但不限於公司出售、合併或其它業務結合、資產處置或進一步優化公司結構。本公司將尋求能釋放股東價值並加速 Golar FLNG 成長管道之解決方案。但無法保證此戰略評估將導致任何交易或其他戰略結果，亦未建立完成此程序之明確時程表。
本公司歷史營運成果可能無法反映未來營運成果，未來營運成果可能受以下原因主要影響：

•FLNG Gimi 的利用率及本公司持續履行 LOA 下的義務。在 LOA 有效期間，本公司仍面臨關鍵風險，包括未達合約容量、付款爭議或違約、合約終止事件，以及未預見的成本或負債。本公司能否維持或提升 FLNG Gimi 的經濟效益，取決於提供一致的營運表現及執行生產最佳化計畫，這可能需要額外的資金投資或法規核准，且可能無法產生預期的回報。任何船舶無法運作、生產不足、重大成本超支、合約終止或長期營運中斷，都可能對本公司營運成果、現金流及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。

•FLNG Hilli 在剩餘 LTA 契約期間的利用率。隨著 LTA 於 2026 年中屆滿，FLNG Hilli 仍具備良好的條件，可於合約期間內提供穩定的生產及強勁的現金流。本公司持續著重於最大化營運時間及表現，以完全實現剩餘合約價值。同時，本公司正在執行有計畫的離開喀麥隆，並已制定明確計畫，以確保符合所有適用的法律、稅務、社會及環境要求。透過主動與利害關係人溝通，本公司致力於負責任地完成轉移，同時保護股東價值及財務表現。然而，任何未能符合適用要求或未能按計畫執行轉移，都可能對本公司營運成果、現金流及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。

•FLNG Hill 的預部署翻新工程按時且在預算內完成。在 LTA 合約屆滿後，FLNG Hilli 將執行一項預計 350 百萬美元的翻新計畫，以升級船舶並延長其經濟壽命，以便於 2026 年後與 SESA 在阿根廷重新部署。此投資預期將使 Hilli 在新合約下產生長期穩定的現金流，並強化該資產在本公司資產組閤中的戰略價值。本公司需履行與 SESA 的某些契約義務，包括按時將船舶送至現場及符合協議的技術性能規格。雖然本公司已建立詳細的專案計畫及監督架構以支持嚴謹的執行，但翻新工程仍面臨常見專案風險，包括承包商表現及延誤、成本膨脹及供應鏈限制。任何重大延誤、成本超支或未能符合契約規格，都可能導致收入減少或延後，以及高於預期的資本支出，這可能會對本公司營運成果、現金流及財務狀況造成不利影響。

•MKII FLNG 按時且在預算內完成轉換。MKII FLNG 是 Golar 首次應用 MKII 設計，並由 SESA 籤訂 20 年合約。轉換需要大量的技術執行、複雜的專案管理及大量的資金投資。此外，本公司需符合 SESA 合約中規定的交付里程碑及性能標準。與任何大型轉換專案一樣，執行會受到風險影響，包括承包商表現及延誤、成本增加、供應鏈限制及許可或法規核准。任何重大延誤、成本超支或未能達成契約性能規格，都可能對專案經濟效益造成負面影響，並延誤收入產生的開始。
•客戶集中度。本公司營運收入來自有限數量的客戶，根據長期合約產生，其中之一將於 2026 年 7 月屆滿。與轉移資產相關的暫時性收入減少，可能對本公司營運成果、現金流及財務狀況造成不利影響。此暫時性收入及現金流缺口預期將隨著 FLNG Hilli 開始與 SESA 的 20 年合約於 2027 年運作，以及 MKII FLNG 於 2028 年開始運作而逐漸縮小，大幅強化本公司收入基礎。

paragraphs: 下列風險因素總結並詳細說明，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果及普通股交易價格產生重大且不利的影響。我們根據風險是否源自FLNG專案、FLNG營運、融資活動、我們所處產業、普通股相關事項及稅務等領域，將風險進行分類。這些風險的呈現順序反映管理層對其相對重要性的評估。在相關情況下，我們已將相關風險歸類至以下類別：
■我們能否履行與FLNG Hilli翻新及MKII FLNG轉換及其各自租賃協議轉為SESA相關的義務；
■我們對具備相關專業經驗的有限數量承包商、供應商及船廠的嚴重依賴，考慮到FLNG轉換的複雜性；
■我們能否開發、結構化並執行符合特定客戶需求及轉換策略的第四艘FLNG；
■我們能否履行與FLNG Gimi簽訂的LOA協議下的持續義務；
■我們能否履行與FLNG Hilli簽訂的LTA協議下的持續義務；
